decisions.reason: Explains the alpha.1 removal and alpha.2 restoration of ignorable retention and applies the final alpha.2 state to the producer.
Identifies the delete line and stale comment, recommends removing the defense and rationale, and distinguishes deleting stripping code from deleting the marker.

Identifies the lack of a public ignorable parameter, rejects casts and unsupported seams, and defers any real integration to verified supported API support.
